proposal_locations: section 6 F7b2 and discriminating power check
findings.claim_paraphrase: Git rejects a delete/add pair exactly at its rename threshold, so a 50 percent pair yields delete plus add; the prototype inclusion boundary differs and F7b2 discriminates that difference.
findings.verdict: The documentation says more than in an example, but the same-version implementation rejects similarity strictly below minimum_score. Equality remains eligible for matching; an unconditional delete/add result at equality is unsupported and contradicted. This also cannot be inferred from the prototype line-ratio score because Git uses a different byte-based metric.
findings.why_consequential: The false Git behavior is repeatedly presented as a source-backed correction, defines N3 boundary rationale, and supplies the proposed F7b2 failure oracle. It is enough to prevent a full research-quality pass.
